string.name: BackgroundAbility_desc
string.value: DSHM background ability bound to the system tray

string.name: activity_motion_reason
string.value: The framework needs to perceive user activity status and operating hand information for holding-side recognition and interaction optimization.

string.name: background_task_reason
string.value: The framework requires background running permission to ensure long-running tasks are not interrupted in the background.

string.name: detect_gesture_reason
string.value: The framework needs to detect user holding gestures for adaptive UI layout and holding-aware navigation.

string.name: store_persistent_reason
string.value: DSHM persists runtime and workspace data on this device so you can keep working offline.

string.name: read_write_user_file_reason
string.value: DSHM reads and writes files and folders you choose for workspaces, sessions, and configuration.

string.name: file_access_reason
string.value: Access to folders you select is required for reading and writing DSH workspace files and persisting grants.

string.name: full_disk_access_reason
string.value: DSHM needs full disk access to open, read, and write project files in any workspace directory you choose.

string.name: download_dir_reason
string.value: DSHM needs read/write access to your Download folder so the agent can open and save project files there.

string.name: documents_dir_reason
string.value: DSHM needs read/write access to your Documents folder so the agent can open and save project files there.

string.name: jit_fort_memory_reason
string.value: V8 JIT for the embedded Node.js runtime: faster cold start and native WebAssembly/fetch support. All JavaScript ships inside the signed app package; no downloaded unsigned code is executed.

string.name: external_native_code_reason
string.value: Execute signed native binaries bundled in this app (busybox applets and terminal pty helper) to provide the local terminal capability.
